invariants.rule: parse_result and relationship, and wallet_role when non-null, are members of their frozen vocabularies
semantic_fingerprint is non-null exactly when parse_result is VERIFIED_GENESIS or VERIFIED_HEAD
state_changed is non-null exactly when parse_result is verified
inner_preimage_text, step_1_signature, step_2_signature, completed_transaction_text, and completed_transaction_sha256 are all non-null exactly when parse_result is VERIFIED_HEAD
VERIFIED_GENESIS requires wallet_role='genesis', s_signature='', p_signature='', b_amount='0', and null head material

VERIFIED_HEAD requires wallet_role in {sender,receiver}, padded s/step_1/step_2 signatures, empty-or-padded p_signature, non-null b_amount, and non-empty inner_preimage_text and completed_transaction_text
a non-verified parse_result requires relationship='NOT_APPLICABLE' and null wallet_role, s_signature, p_signature, b_amount, and all head material

endpoint_fingerprint/raw_response_sha256 and any non-null semantic_fingerprint/completed_transaction_sha256 match sha256_hex; wallet_public_key matches padded_base64url_pubkey; any non-null b_amount matches zkz_balance_text; wallet_seq is a positive integer; raw_response_bytes is present

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: observer_id
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: observing domain identity; read stream is (observer_id, wallet_public_key)

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: endpoint_fingerprint
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: the independently configured endpoint selected for this read

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: wallet_public_key
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: queried wallet; external addresses have no wallet_id

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: observed_at
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: capture / request timing; never a uniqueness or sequencing key

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: http_status
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: transport status; null when no HTTP response arrived

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: raw_response_bytes
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: complete body exactly as received, before UTF-8 decode or JSON parse

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: raw_response_octets
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: byte length of raw_response_bytes; a consecutive-dedup comparison key

RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.name: raw_response_sha256
RAW_OBSERVATION_CAPTURE_FIELDS.note: SHA-256 of raw_response_bytes; a candidate index, not equality authority

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: endpoint_fingerprint
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: copied per row so later reconfiguration cannot rewrite provenance

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: wallet_id
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: optional projection for a node-owned wallet; null for external addresses

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: raw_response_bytes
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: authoritative evidence; never JSONB; never parse/re-serialized by retention jobs

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: raw_response_sha256
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: candidate index; equality still recomputes length and compares exact bytes

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: relationship
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: what the fresh response proved at capture; immutable

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: semantic_fingerprint
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: present iff verified (CHECK A); computed only after complete verification

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: wallet_role
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: sender | receiver | genesis; null when non-verified (CHECK F)

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: s_signature
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: current state signature; empty string at genesis

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: p_signature
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: previous state signature; empty string permitted

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: b_amount
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: role-relative absolute balance; '0' is legal (canonical ZKZ balance domain)

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: completed_transaction_text
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: exact complete body, top-level sequence inner, step_1_signature, step_2_signature; head only; never reconstructed from projections

GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.name: previous_recorded_observation_id
GATEWAY_OBSERVATION_RECORD_FIELDS.note: dedup linkage to the immediately prior recorded row; references gateway_observations(id)

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: last_recorded_observation_id
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: the most recently appended row for this stream

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: last_raw_response_sha256
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: candidate index for the consecutive byte-identical check

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: last_semantic_fingerprint
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: prior verified semantic identity, when the last row was verified

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: last_seen_at
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: updated on every sighting, appended or suppressed

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: consecutive_repeat_count
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: count of suppressed byte-identical verified repeats since the last appended row

WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.name: next_wallet_seq
WALLET_OBSERVATION_CURSOR_FIELDS.note: allocator for the next appended row's wallet_seq

OBSERVATION_ANOMALY_RECORD_FIELDS.name: observation_id
OBSERVATION_ANOMALY_RECORD_FIELDS.note: unique; references the appended gateway_observations row

OBSERVATION_ANOMALY_RECORD_FIELDS.name: prior_observation_id
OBSERVATION_ANOMALY_RECORD_FIELDS.note: the prior accepted state this anomaly was judged against, when applicable

COMPARISON_LADDER: raw byte length, digest, then exact bytes decide suppress vs append (the byte-dedup primitive)
among appended verified rows, an equal semantic fingerprint is EQUIVALENT_STATE_DIFFERENT_ENVELOPE (envelope change, not state change)
a differing semantic fingerprint is a state transition classified by backlink and state-signature comparison

RELATIONSHIP_CLASSIFICATION_RULES.action: establish cursor; operation policy decides usability

RELATIONSHIP_CLASSIFICATION_RULES.condition: raw bytes differ, semantic fingerprint equal to prior
new P equals prior S and new S differs from prior S
new S equals prior S but semantic fingerprint differs
new genesis after prior non-genesis history
new S equals an accepted S below current
new state differs and new P does not equal prior S

NON_CLASSIFIER_RELATIONSHIPS.DUPLICATE: diagnostic only; a byte-identical verified repeat is suppressed by the byte-dedup primitive and has no row
NON_CLASSIFIER_RELATIONSHIPS.COMPLETE_PATH_SUCCESSOR: derived only by a complete-path adjudication, never at capture
NON_CLASSIFIER_RELATIONSHIPS.NOT_APPLICABLE: non-verified rows only; set by the record contract, not the classifier

GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.name: AA_BYTE_IDENTICAL
GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.description: byte-identical verified A,A appends once and increments the sighting counter

GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.name: AA_PRIME_WRAPPER
GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.description: same verified head with a byte-different envelope A,A' appends twice

GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.name: ABCA_REGRESSION
GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.description: A,B,C,A appends four; the final A is a REGRESSION and quarantines

GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.name: MALFORMED_XX
GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.description: identical malformed bytes twice appends twice with two anomalies

GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.name: DIGEST_COLLISION
GOLDEN_SEQUENCES.description: two verified bodies with a forced-equal digest and length but different bytes still append

SEQUENCE_PROPERTIES: restart: resuming from a returned cursor yields the identical continuation transcript
concurrent: each read stream folds an independent cursor with its own contiguous wallet_seq
append-only: a row count never decreases and a suppressed sighting never removes a row
